name: K46 leavesOpen: a line with no value drops one more character after the prefix

name: K47 leavesOpen: a line with no value is read with its dash prefix
why: equivalent: the prefix ends in a blank, so the first character after it is preceded by one whether or not the prefix is cut (leavesOpen treats the start of the value and a blank alike), and `-` and a blank are none of the characters it looks for; run against the parent over 1,516,856 front matters (379,214 lines in four places) with no difference, and the 31 caller rows and jupyter-kernel.test.ts pass with it
